headline: Parking lot expansion at Marina Park West Lot and reconstruction of Narrow River boat ramp at Mitchell and Pollock Ave.
summary: The agenda covers public access to the water at Washington Street in Matunuck. It also covers the Marina Park West Lot parking expansion, the Narrow River boat ramp, and a potential salt marsh restoration at Succotash Marsh.
items: Narragansett and Charlestown Harbor Commission agenda and minutes
CRMC public notice for File# 2026-08-078 in Narragansett: replace and improve existing timber pier for RIDEM Commercial Fisheries Laboratory
Online GIS map showing South Kingstown rights of way to shore
Public right-of-way access at Locations 10 and 11 under Boats and Waterways Ordinance 4-14, boat storage: PA Site 10, Washington Street, Matunuck, Segar Cove
Boats and Waterways Ordinance revisions and updates
Coastal road and public right-of-way to the water survey and monumentation; Charlestown Beach Road survey status
Expansion of parking lot at Marina Park West Lot to accommodate increased seasonal activity
Marina Park / Town Farm Park master plan with connectivity to downtown Wakefield
Formerly leased waterfront area along Saugatucket River adjacent to Marina Park green space, returning to town operations July 1, 2027
Development of Indian Lake management plan
Planned development of a Saugatucket River watershed plan by RIDEM
Reconstruction of RIDEM Narrow River boat ramp at Mitchell and Pollock Ave
Potential salt marsh restoration project at RIDEM Succotash Marsh Management Area
location: The Neighborhood Guild, 325 Columbia St., Peace Dale, RI
